reason: The component status writer of one service pass, per deployment mode, over an engine of 1,000 and 4,000 pods: it initialises the ready condition, mirrors the autoscaler status (class none) and reads the model-loading state from the Component's pods that carry the raw app label. The pod list is answered the way the informer cache answers it: every pod of the namespace is walked and the matches are deep-copied, five allocations per copied pod. Every RawDeployment pod carries the label; of a MultiNode group of eight only the leader does. An OMENative pod never does, so the writer makes no list for that mode and writes the state as for no pod: 11 allocations, the writer's own. Before, it listed for every mode: the OMENative list walked every pod of the namespace, copied none and cost 20 allocations and 150 microseconds at 4,000 pods.
